subject: cube geometry substitution through the hand draw hook

mechanism.geometry: private VAO + VBO + IBO created at the first owned draw
mechanism.engine_buffers: never read or written; only the engine VAO is bound and restored
mechanism.game_bytes_restored: nothing to restore because game buffers are untouched

live_debug.bitmask_meaning: all eight resolved: bind, subdata, gen buffers, gen VAO, bind VAO, attrib pointer, enable attrib, getIntegerv
live_debug.note: the counters were read live from the running process with GDB

visual_result.interpretation: the hook owns both passes and the original arm is replaced, but the replacement geometry has not yet been made visible; this is not yet a usable geometry replacement

findings: opengl32.dll is loaded after mod initialization, so GL entry points must be resolved lazily at the first owned draw.
wglGetProcAddress returns NULL for GL 1.1 glGetIntegerv; it must come from GetProcAddress on opengl32.
The first buffer-read approach (glGetBufferSubData inside the draw) never produced a ready state and the game exited; the private-VAO approach reaches ready and substitutes every draw.
unverified_changes: Querying glGetAttribLocation for in_position/in_normal/in_uv0/in_uv1/in_tangent and binding the cube at those locations.
Disabling GL_DEPTH_TEST and GL_CULL_FACE for the cube draw and restoring them afterwards.
The live run after these changes stopped at the title screen, so they have not been observed in gameplay.
next_step: Enter gameplay again, read debug slots 8-12 for the real attribute locations, and make the cube rasterize before replacing it with the baked arm mesh.
